					NOT = { var:zg361_p3_portfolio_cycle = root.var:zg361_review_serial }
				}

# Internal domain entry. Call in assessed-subject scope with ROOT = frozen manager.
zg361_p3_aa_launch_effect = {
	remove_variable = zg361_p3_runtime_applied
	zg361_case_aa_open_effect = yes
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = zg361_case_kernel_applied var:zg361_case_kernel_applied = 1 }

		zg361_p3_initialize_portfolio_effect = yes
		zg361_p3_aa_initialize_effect = yes
		var:zg361_case_aa_owner = { save_scope_as = zg361_p3_aa_owner }
		save_scope_as = zg361_p3_aa_subject
		save_scope_value_as = { name = zg361_p3_aa_cycle value = var:zg361_case_aa_cycle_serial }
		save_scope_value_as = { name = zg361_p3_aa_case value = var:zg361_case_aa_case_serial }
		if = {
			limit = { root = { is_ai = yes zg361_is_celestial_liege_trigger = yes } }
			zg361_p3_aa_run_authorized_ai_effect = yes
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { root = { is_ai = no zg361_is_celestial_liege_trigger = yes } }
			scope:zg361_p3_aa_owner = { trigger_event = { id = zg361p3.229 } }
		}
	}
}

# Assessed-only read adapter: counts/barons can consume their own active case,
# but this effect grants no open, stage, HC, calibration or allocation authority.
zg361_p3_ag_subject_read_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			zg361_case_kernel_subject_self_guard_trigger = {
				SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_ag_subject
				ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_ag_active
			}
		}
		set_variable = { name = zg361_p3_ag_subject_seen_revision value = var:zg361_p3_ag_visible_revision }
	}
}

# #229 next-cycle route-C debt consumer.  The exact frozen
# owner receives the KPI sink; every other pending state blocks new lifecycle work.
zg361_p3_m229_consume_due_debt_effect = {
	remove_variable = zg361_p3_m229_debt_expected_due_cycle
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = zg361_p3_m229_debt_cycle }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_p3_m229_debt_expected_due_cycle value = var:zg361_p3_m229_debt_cycle }
		change_variable = { name = zg361_p3_m229_debt_expected_due_cycle add = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_variable = zg361_p3_m229_debt_owner
			has_variable = zg361_p3_m229_debt_subject
			has_variable = zg361_p3_m229_debt_cycle
			has_variable = zg361_p3_m229_debt_case
			has_variable = zg361_p3_m229_debt_state
			has_variable = zg361_p3_m229_debt_mechanism
			has_variable = zg361_p3_m229_debt_due_cycle
			has_variable = zg361_p3_m229_debt_status
			has_variable = zg361_p3_m229_debt_audit_state
			has_variable = zg361_p3_m229_debt_business_object_created
			has_variable = zg361_p3_m229_receipt_owner
			has_variable = zg361_p3_m229_receipt_subject
			has_variable = zg361_p3_m229_receipt_cycle
			has_variable = zg361_p3_m229_receipt_case
			has_variable = zg361_p3_m229_receipt_state
			has_variable = zg361_p3_m229_receipt_choice
			has_variable = zg361_p3_m229_debt_expected_due_cycle
			has_variable = zg361_p3_policy_debt_open_n
			has_variable = zg361_p3_policy_debt_settled_n
			root = {
				zg361_is_celestial_liege_trigger = yes
				has_variable = zg361_review_serial
			}
			zg361_is_reviewable_vassal_trigger = yes
			liege = root
			var:zg361_p3_m229_debt_status = 1
			var:zg361_p3_m229_debt_audit_state = 1
			var:zg361_p3_m229_debt_business_object_created = 0
			var:zg361_p3_m229_debt_mechanism = 229
			var:zg361_p3_policy_debt_open_n >= 1
			var:zg361_p3_m229_debt_owner = root
			var:zg361_p3_m229_debt_subject = this
		var:zg361_p3_m229_debt_owner = var:zg361_p3_m229_receipt_owner
		var:zg361_p3_m229_debt_subject = var:zg361_p3_m229_receipt_subject
		var:zg361_p3_m229_debt_cycle = var:zg361_p3_m229_receipt_cycle
		var:zg361_p3_m229_debt_case = var:zg361_p3_m229_receipt_case
		var:zg361_p3_m229_debt_state = var:zg361_p3_m229_receipt_state
			var:zg361_p3_m229_receipt_choice = 3
			var:zg361_p3_m229_debt_due_cycle = var:zg361_p3_m229_debt_expected_due_cycle
			root.var:zg361_review_serial = var:zg361_p3_m229_debt_due_cycle
		}
		var:zg361_p3_m229_debt_owner = {
			change_variable = { name = zg361_b2_management_debt add = 1 }
		}
		set_variable = { name = zg361_p3_m229_debt_status value = 2 }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_p3_m229_debt_audit_state value = 3 }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_p3_m229_debt_settled_by value = root }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_p3_m229_debt_settled_cycle value = root.var:zg361_review_serial }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_p3_m229_debt_performance_sink value = 1 }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_p3_m229_debt_consumer_status value = 1 }
		change_variable = { name = zg361_p3_policy_debt_open_n add = -1 }
		change_variable = { name = zg361_p3_policy_debt_settled_n add = 1 }
	}
	else_if = {
		# Exact settled replay is audit-only and never reaches the KPI sink again.
		limit = {
			has_variable = zg361_p3_m229_debt_owner
			has_variable = zg361_p3_m229_debt_subject
			has_variable = zg361_p3_m229_debt_status
			has_variable = zg361_p3_m229_debt_audit_state
			has_variable = zg361_p3_m229_debt_settled_by
			has_variable = zg361_p3_m229_debt_settled_cycle
			root = {
				zg361_is_celestial_liege_trigger = yes
				has_variable = zg361_review_serial
			}
			zg361_is_reviewable_vassal_trigger = yes

			var:zg361_p3_m229_debt_owner = root
			var:zg361_p3_m229_debt_subject = this
			var:zg361_p3_m229_debt_status = 2
			var:zg361_p3_m229_debt_audit_state = 3
			var:zg361_p3_m229_debt_settled_by = root
			root.var:zg361_review_serial >= var:zg361_p3_m229_debt_settled_cycle
		}
		set_variable = { name = zg361_p3_m229_debt_consumer_status value = 2 }
	}
	else_if = {
		# Complete exact input whose due cycle is later is future, never current work.
		limit = {
			has_variable = zg361_p3_m229_debt_owner
			has_variable = zg361_p3_m229_debt_subject
			has_variable = zg361_p3_m229_debt_cycle
			has_variable = zg361_p3_m229_debt_case
			has_variable = zg361_p3_m229_debt_state
			has_variable = zg361_p3_m229_debt_mechanism
			has_variable = zg361_p3_m229_debt_due_cycle
			has_variable = zg361_p3_m229_debt_status
			has_variable = zg361_p3_m229_debt_audit_state
			has_variable = zg361_p3_m229_debt_business_object_created
			has_variable = zg361_p3_m229_receipt_owner
			has_variable = zg361_p3_m229_receipt_subject

# #230 next-cycle route-C debt consumer.  The exact frozen
# owner receives the KPI sink; every other pending state blocks new lifecycle work.
zg361_p3_m230_consume_due_debt_effect = {
	remove_variable = zg361_p3_m230_debt_expected_due_cycle
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = zg361_p3_m230_debt_cycle }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_p3_m230_debt_expected_due_cycle value = var:zg361_p3_m230_debt_cycle }
		change_variable = { name = zg361_p3_m230_debt_expected_due_cycle add = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_variable = zg361_p3_m230_debt_owner
			has_variable = zg361_p3_m230_debt_subject
			has_variable = zg361_p3_m230_debt_cycle
			has_variable = zg361_p3_m230_debt_case
			has_variable = zg361_p3_m230_debt_state
			has_variable = zg361_p3_m230_debt_mechanism
			has_variable = zg361_p3_m230_debt_due_cycle
			has_variable = zg361_p3_m230_debt_status
			has_variable = zg361_p3_m230_debt_audit_state
			has_variable = zg361_p3_m230_debt_business_object_created
			has_variable = zg361_p3_m230_receipt_owner
			has_variable = zg361_p3_m230_receipt_subject
			has_variable = zg361_p3_m230_receipt_cycle
			has_variable = zg361_p3_m230_receipt_case
			has_variable = zg361_p3_m230_receipt_state
			has_variable = zg361_p3_m230_receipt_choice
			has_variable = zg361_p3_m230_debt_expected_due_cycle
			has_variable = zg361_p3_policy_debt_open_n
			has_variable = zg361_p3_policy_debt_settled_n
			root = {
				zg361_is_celestial_liege_trigger = yes
				has_variable = zg361_review_serial
			}
			zg361_is_reviewable_vassal_trigger = yes
			liege = root
			var:zg361_p3_m230_debt_status = 1
			var:zg361_p3_m230_debt_audit_state = 1
			var:zg361_p3_m230_debt_business_object_created = 0
			var:zg361_p3_m230_debt_mechanism = 230
			var:zg361_p3_policy_debt_open_n >= 1
			var:zg361_p3_m230_debt_owner = root
			var:zg361_p3_m230_debt_subject = this
		var:zg361_p3_m230_debt_owner = var:zg361_p3_m230_receipt_owner
		var:zg361_p3_m230_debt_subject = var:zg361_p3_m230_receipt_subject
		var:zg361_p3_m230_debt_cycle = var:zg361_p3_m230_receipt_cycle
		var:zg361_p3_m230_debt_case = var:zg361_p3_m230_receipt_case
		var:zg361_p3_m230_debt_state = var:zg361_p3_m230_receipt_state
			var:zg361_p3_m230_receipt_choice = 3
			var:zg361_p3_m230_debt_due_cycle = var:zg361_p3_m230_debt_expected_due_cycle
			root.var:zg361_review_serial = var:zg361_p3_m230_debt_due_cycle
		}
		var:zg361_p3_m230_debt_owner = {
			change_variable = { name = zg361_b2_management_debt add = 1 }
		}
		set_variable = { name = zg361_p3_m230_debt_status value = 2 }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_p3_m230_debt_audit_state value = 3 }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_p3_m230_debt_settled_by value = root }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_p3_m230_debt_settled_cycle value = root.var:zg361_review_serial }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_p3_m230_debt_performance_sink value = 1 }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_p3_m230_debt_consumer_status value = 1 }
		change_variable = { name = zg361_p3_policy_debt_open_n add = -1 }
		change_variable = { name = zg361_p3_policy_debt_settled_n add = 1 }
	}
	else_if = {
		# Exact settled replay is audit-only and never reaches the KPI sink again.
		limit = {
			has_variable = zg361_p3_m230_debt_owner
			has_variable = zg361_p3_m230_debt_subject
			has_variable = zg361_p3_m230_debt_status
			has_variable = zg361_p3_m230_debt_audit_state
			has_variable = zg361_p3_m230_debt_settled_by

				zg361_is_celestial_liege_trigger = yes
				has_variable = zg361_review_serial
			}

			var:zg361_p3_m230_debt_owner = root
			var:zg361_p3_m230_debt_subject = this
			var:zg361_p3_m230_debt_status = 2
			var:zg361_p3_m230_debt_audit_state = 3
			var:zg361_p3_m230_debt_settled_by = root
			root.var:zg361_review_serial >= var:zg361_p3_m230_debt_settled_cycle
		}
		set_variable = { name = zg361_p3_m230_debt_consumer_status value = 2 }
	}
	else_if = {
		# Complete exact input whose due cycle is later is future, never current work.
		limit = {
			has_variable = zg361_p3_m230_debt_owner
			has_variable = zg361_p3_m230_debt_subject
			has_variable = zg361_p3_m230_debt_cycle
			has_variable = zg361_p3_m230_debt_case
			has_variable = zg361_p3_m230_debt_state
			has_variable = zg361_p3_m230_debt_mechanism
			has_variable = zg361_p3_m230_debt_due_cycle
			has_variable = zg361_p3_m230_debt_status
			has_variable = zg361_p3_m230_debt_audit_state
			has_variable = zg361_p3_m230_debt_business_object_created
			has_variable = zg361_p3_m230_receipt_owner
			has_variable = zg361_p3_m230_receipt_subject
			has_variable = zg361_p3_m230_receipt_cycle
			has_variable = zg361_p3_m230_receipt_case
			has_variable = zg361_p3_m230_receipt_state
			has_variable = zg361_p3_m230_receipt_choice
			has_variable = zg361_p3_m230_debt_expected_due_cycle
			root = {
				zg361_is_celestial_liege_trigger = yes
				has_variable = zg361_review_serial
			}
			zg361_is_reviewable_vassal_trigger = yes
			liege = root
			var:zg361_p3_m230_debt_status = 1
			var:zg361_p3_m230_debt_audit_state = 1
			var:zg361_p3_m230_debt_business_object_created = 0
			var:zg361_p3_m230_debt_mechanism = 230
			var:zg361_p3_m230_debt_owner = root
			var:zg361_p3_m230_debt_subject = this
		var:zg361_p3_m230_debt_owner = var:zg361_p3_m230_receipt_owner
		var:zg361_p3_m230_debt_subject = var:zg361_p3_m230_receipt_subject
		var:zg361_p3_m230_debt_cycle = var:zg361_p3_m230_receipt_cycle
		var:zg361_p3_m230_debt_case = var:zg361_p3_m230_receipt_case
		var:zg361_p3_m230_debt_state = var:zg361_p3_m230_receipt_state
			var:zg361_p3_m230_receipt_choice = 3
			var:zg361_p3_m230_debt_due_cycle = var:zg361_p3_m230_debt_expected_due_cycle
			root.var:zg361_review_serial < var:zg361_p3_m230_debt_due_cycle
		}
		set_variable = { name = zg361_p3_m230_debt_consumer_status value = 5 }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_p3_policy_debt_consumer_blocked value = 1 }
	}
	else_if = {
		# Pending stale/cross-owner/corrupt identity: fail closed.
		limit = {
			OR = {
				trigger_if = {
					limit = { has_variable = zg361_p3_m230_debt_status }
					var:zg361_p3_m230_debt_status = 1
				}
				trigger_else = { always = no }
				trigger_if = {
					limit = { has_variable = zg361_p3_m230_receipt_choice }
					var:zg361_p3_m230_receipt_choice = 3
				}
				trigger_else = { always = no }
			}
		}
		set_variable = { name = zg361_p3_m230_debt_consumer_status value = 3 }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_p3_policy_debt_consumer_blocked value = 1 }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_p3_last_red_code value = 60230 }
	}
}

# #232 next-cycle route-C debt consumer.  The exact frozen
# owner receives the KPI sink; every other pending state blocks new lifecycle work.
zg361_p3_m232_consume_due_debt_effect = {
	remove_variable = zg361_p3_m232_debt_expected_due_cycle
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = zg361_p3_m232_debt_cycle }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_p3_m232_debt_expected_due_cycle value = var:zg361_p3_m232_debt_cycle }
		change_variable = { name = zg361_p3_m232_debt_expected_due_cycle add = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_variable = zg361_p3_m232_debt_owner
			has_variable = zg361_p3_m232_debt_subject

# #233 next-cycle route-C debt consumer.  The exact frozen
# owner receives the KPI sink; every other pending state blocks new lifecycle work.
zg361_p3_m233_consume_due_debt_effect = {
	remove_variable = zg361_p3_m233_debt_expected_due_cycle
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = zg361_p3_m233_debt_cycle }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_p3_m233_debt_expected_due_cycle value = var:zg361_p3_m233_debt_cycle }
		change_variable = { name = zg361_p3_m233_debt_expected_due_cycle add = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_variable = zg361_p3_m233_debt_owner
			has_variable = zg361_p3_m233_debt_subject
			has_variable = zg361_p3_m233_debt_cycle
			has_variable = zg361_p3_m233_debt_case
			has_variable = zg361_p3_m233_debt_state

			has_variable = zg361_p3_m233_debt_audit_state
			has_variable = zg361_p3_m233_debt_business_object_created
			has_variable = zg361_p3_m233_receipt_owner
			has_variable = zg361_p3_m233_receipt_subject
			has_variable = zg361_p3_m233_receipt_cycle
			has_variable = zg361_p3_m233_receipt_case
			has_variable = zg361_p3_m233_receipt_state
			has_variable = zg361_p3_m233_receipt_choice
			has_variable = zg361_p3_m233_debt_expected_due_cycle
			has_variable = zg361_p3_policy_debt_open_n
			has_variable = zg361_p3_policy_debt_settled_n
			root = {
				zg361_is_celestial_liege_trigger = yes
				has_variable = zg361_review_serial
			}
			zg361_is_reviewable_vassal_trigger = yes
			liege = root
			var:zg361_p3_m233_debt_status = 1
			var:zg361_p3_m233_debt_audit_state = 1
			var:zg361_p3_m233_debt_business_object_created = 0
			var:zg361_p3_m233_debt_mechanism = 233
			var:zg361_p3_policy_debt_open_n >= 1
			var:zg361_p3_m233_debt_owner = root
			var:zg361_p3_m233_debt_subject = this
		var:zg361_p3_m233_debt_owner = var:zg361_p3_m233_receipt_owner
		var:zg361_p3_m233_debt_subject = var:zg361_p3_m233_receipt_subject
		var:zg361_p3_m233_debt_cycle = var:zg361_p3_m233_receipt_cycle

			var:zg361_p3_m233_receipt_choice = 3
			var:zg361_p3_m233_debt_due_cycle = var:zg361_p3_m233_debt_expected_due_cycle
			root.var:zg361_review_serial = var:zg361_p3_m233_debt_due_cycle
		}
		var:zg361_p3_m233_debt_owner = {
			change_variable = { name = zg361_b2_management_debt add = 1 }
		}
		set_variable = { name = zg361_p3_m233_debt_status value = 2 }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_p3_m233_debt_audit_state value = 3 }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_p3_m233_debt_settled_by value = root }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_p3_m233_debt_settled_cycle value = root.var:zg361_review_serial }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_p3_m233_debt_performance_sink value = 1 }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_p3_m233_debt_consumer_status value = 1 }
		change_variable = { name = zg361_p3_policy_debt_open_n add = -1 }
		change_variable = { name = zg361_p3_policy_debt_settled_n add = 1 }
	}
	else_if = {
		# Exact settled replay is audit-only and never reaches the KPI sink again.
		limit = {

		}
		set_variable = { name = zg361_p3_m233_debt_consumer_status value = 2 }
	}
	else_if = {
		# Complete exact input whose due cycle is later is future, never current work.
		limit = {
			has_variable = zg361_p3_m233_debt_owner
			has_variable = zg361_p3_m233_debt_subject

		var:zg361_p3_m233_debt_subject = var:zg361_p3_m233_receipt_subject
		var:zg361_p3_m233_debt_cycle = var:zg361_p3_m233_receipt_cycle

		set_variable = { name = zg361_p3_policy_debt_consumer_blocked value = 1 }
	}
	else_if = {

		limit = {

		set_variable = { name = zg361_p3_runtime_status value = 2 } # idempotent no-op
	}
	else = { set_variable = { name = zg361_p3_runtime_status value = 3 } } # stale no-op
}

	}
	else_if = {
		# Complete exact input whose due cycle is later is future, never current work.
		limit = {
			has_variable = zg361_p3_m234_debt_owner

	}
	else_if = {
		# Pending stale/cross-owner/corrupt identity: fail closed.
		limit = {

# #235 next-cycle route-C debt consumer.  The exact frozen
# owner receives the KPI sink; every other pending state blocks new lifecycle work.
zg361_p3_m235_consume_due_debt_effect = {
	remove_variable = zg361_p3_m235_debt_expected_due_cycle
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = zg361_p3_m235_debt_cycle }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_p3_m235_debt_expected_due_cycle value = var:zg361_p3_m235_debt_cycle }
		change_variable = { name = zg361_p3_m235_debt_expected_due_cycle add = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_variable = zg361_p3_m235_debt_owner
			has_variable = zg361_p3_m235_debt_subject
			has_variable = zg361_p3_m235_debt_cycle
			has_variable = zg361_p3_m235_debt_case

			has_variable = zg361_p3_m235_debt_business_object_created
			has_variable = zg361_p3_m235_receipt_owner
			has_variable = zg361_p3_m235_receipt_subject

			has_variable = zg361_p3_m235_receipt_state
			has_variable = zg361_p3_m235_receipt_choice
			has_variable = zg361_p3_m235_debt_expected_due_cycle
			has_variable = zg361_p3_policy_debt_open_n
			has_variable = zg361_p3_policy_debt_settled_n
			root = {
				zg361_is_celestial_liege_trigger = yes
				has_variable = zg361_review_serial
			}
			zg361_is_reviewable_vassal_trigger = yes
			liege = root
			var:zg361_p3_m235_debt_status = 1
			var:zg361_p3_m235_debt_audit_state = 1
			var:zg361_p3_m235_debt_business_object_created = 0
			var:zg361_p3_m235_debt_mechanism = 235
			var:zg361_p3_policy_debt_open_n >= 1
			var:zg361_p3_m235_debt_owner = root
			var:zg361_p3_m235_debt_subject = this
		var:zg361_p3_m235_debt_owner = var:zg361_p3_m235_receipt_owner
		var:zg361_p3_m235_debt_subject = var:zg361_p3_m235_receipt_subject

			var:zg361_p3_m235_receipt_choice = 3
			var:zg361_p3_m235_debt_due_cycle = var:zg361_p3_m235_debt_expected_due_cycle
			root.var:zg361_review_serial = var:zg361_p3_m235_debt_due_cycle
		}
		var:zg361_p3_m235_debt_owner = {
			change_variable = { name = zg361_b2_management_debt add = 1 }
		}
		set_variable = { name = zg361_p3_m235_debt_status value = 2 }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_p3_m235_debt_audit_state value = 3 }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_p3_m235_debt_settled_by value = root }

		set_variable = { name = zg361_p3_m235_debt_consumer_status value = 1 }

		change_variable = { name = zg361_p3_policy_debt_settled_n add = 1 }
	}
	else_if = {

	else_if = {

		var:zg361_p3_m235_debt_subject = var:zg361_p3_m235_receipt_subject

		set_variable = { name = zg361_p3_policy_debt_consumer_blocked value = 1 }
	}
	else_if = {
		# Pending stale/cross-owner/corrupt identity: fail closed.
		limit = {
			OR = {
				trigger_if = {
					limit = { has_variable = zg361_p3_m235_debt_status }

				}

		set_variable = { name = zg361_p3_policy_debt_consumer_blocked value = 1 }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_p3_last_red_code value = 60235 }
	}
}

# #236 next-cycle route-C debt consumer.  The exact frozen

zg361_p3_m236_consume_due_debt_effect = {
	remove_variable = zg361_p3_m236_debt_expected_due_cycle

		limit = { has_variable = zg361_p3_m236_debt_cycle }

	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_variable = zg361_p3_m236_debt_owner

		change_variable = { name = zg361_p3_policy_debt_settled_n add = 1 }

	else_if = {

		}
		set_variable = { name = zg361_p3_m236_debt_consumer_status value = 2 }
	}
	else_if = {
		# Complete exact input whose due cycle is later is future, never current work.
		limit = {
			has_variable = zg361_p3_m236_debt_owner
			has_variable = zg361_p3_m236_debt_subject
			has_variable = zg361_p3_m236_debt_cycle

			has_variable = zg361_p3_m236_debt_audit_state

			has_variable = zg361_p3_m236_receipt_subject
			has_variable = zg361_p3_m236_receipt_cycle

		var:zg361_p3_m236_debt_subject = var:zg361_p3_m236_receipt_subject

		set_variable = { name = zg361_p3_policy_debt_consumer_blocked value = 1 }
	}
	else_if = {
		# Pending stale/cross-owner/corrupt identity: fail closed.
		limit = {
			OR = {
				trigger_if = {
					limit = { has_variable = zg361_p3_m236_debt_status }

				}
				trigger_else = { always = no }

		set_variable = { name = zg361_p3_policy_debt_consumer_blocked value = 1 }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_p3_last_red_code value = 60236 }
	}

# #237 next-cycle route-C debt consumer.  The exact frozen
# owner receives the KPI sink; every other pending state blocks new lifecycle work.

	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_variable = zg361_p3_m237_debt_owner

			liege = root

			var:zg361_p3_m237_debt_audit_state = 1

# #240 next-cycle route-C debt consumer.  The exact frozen
# owner receives the KPI sink; every other pending state blocks new lifecycle work.
zg361_p3_m240_consume_due_debt_effect = {
	remove_variable = zg361_p3_m240_debt_expected_due_cycle
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = zg361_p3_m240_debt_cycle }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_p3_m240_debt_expected_due_cycle value = var:zg361_p3_m240_debt_cycle }
		change_variable = { name = zg361_p3_m240_debt_expected_due_cycle add = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_variable = zg361_p3_m240_debt_owner
			has_variable = zg361_p3_m240_debt_subject
			has_variable = zg361_p3_m240_debt_cycle
			has_variable = zg361_p3_m240_debt_case
			has_variable = zg361_p3_m240_debt_state

			has_variable = zg361_p3_m240_debt_audit_state
			has_variable = zg361_p3_m240_debt_business_object_created
			has_variable = zg361_p3_m240_receipt_owner
			has_variable = zg361_p3_m240_receipt_subject
			has_variable = zg361_p3_m240_receipt_cycle
			has_variable = zg361_p3_m240_receipt_case
			has_variable = zg361_p3_m240_receipt_state
			has_variable = zg361_p3_m240_receipt_choice
			has_variable = zg361_p3_m240_debt_expected_due_cycle
			has_variable = zg361_p3_policy_debt_open_n
			has_variable = zg361_p3_policy_debt_settled_n
			root = {
				zg361_is_celestial_liege_trigger = yes
				has_variable = zg361_review_serial
			}
			zg361_is_reviewable_vassal_trigger = yes
			liege = root
			var:zg361_p3_m240_debt_status = 1
			var:zg361_p3_m240_debt_audit_state = 1
			var:zg361_p3_m240_debt_business_object_created = 0
			var:zg361_p3_m240_debt_mechanism = 240
			var:zg361_p3_policy_debt_open_n >= 1
			var:zg361_p3_m240_debt_owner = root
			var:zg361_p3_m240_debt_subject = this
		var:zg361_p3_m240_debt_owner = var:zg361_p3_m240_receipt_owner
		var:zg361_p3_m240_debt_subject = var:zg361_p3_m240_receipt_subject

			root.var:zg361_review_serial = var:zg361_p3_m240_debt_due_cycle
		}
		var:zg361_p3_m240_debt_owner = {
			change_variable = { name = zg361_b2_management_debt add = 1 }
		}
		set_variable = { name = zg361_p3_m240_debt_status value = 2 }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_p3_m240_debt_audit_state value = 3 }

		change_variable = { name = zg361_p3_policy_debt_settled_n add = 1 }

	else_if = {

		set_variable = { name = zg361_p3_m240_debt_consumer_status value = 2 }
	}
	else_if = {
		# Complete exact input whose due cycle is later is future, never current work.
		limit = {
			has_variable = zg361_p3_m240_debt_owner
			has_variable = zg361_p3_m240_debt_subject

		var:zg361_p3_m240_debt_subject = var:zg361_p3_m240_receipt_subject

			root.var:zg361_review_serial < var:zg361_p3_m240_debt_due_cycle

		set_variable = { name = zg361_p3_policy_debt_consumer_blocked value = 1 }
	}
	else_if = {
		# Pending stale/cross-owner/corrupt identity: fail closed.
		limit = {
			OR = {
				trigger_if = {
					limit = { has_variable = zg361_p3_m240_debt_status }
					var:zg361_p3_m240_debt_status = 1
				}

		set_variable = { name = zg361_p3_policy_debt_consumer_blocked value = 1 }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_p3_last_red_code value = 60240 }
	}

# #239 next-cycle route-C debt consumer.  The exact frozen
# owner receives the KPI sink; every other pending state blocks new lifecycle work.
zg361_p3_m239_consume_due_debt_effect = {
	remove_variable = zg361_p3_m239_debt_expected_due_cycle
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = zg361_p3_m239_debt_cycle }

		change_variable = { name = zg361_p3_m239_debt_expected_due_cycle add = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_variable = zg361_p3_m239_debt_owner
			has_variable = zg361_p3_m239_debt_subject

# #301 next-cycle route-C debt consumer.  The exact frozen
# owner receives the KPI sink; every other pending state blocks new lifecycle work.
zg361_p3_m301_consume_due_debt_effect = {
	remove_variable = zg361_p3_m301_debt_expected_due_cycle
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = zg361_p3_m301_debt_cycle }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_p3_m301_debt_expected_due_cycle value = var:zg361_p3_m301_debt_cycle }
		change_variable = { name = zg361_p3_m301_debt_expected_due_cycle add = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_variable = zg361_p3_m301_debt_owner
			has_variable = zg361_p3_m301_debt_subject
			has_variable = zg361_p3_m301_debt_cycle
			has_variable = zg361_p3_m301_debt_case
			has_variable = zg361_p3_m301_debt_state
			has_variable = zg361_p3_m301_debt_mechanism

			has_variable = zg361_p3_m301_debt_audit_state
			has_variable = zg361_p3_m301_debt_business_object_created
			has_variable = zg361_p3_m301_receipt_owner
			has_variable = zg361_p3_m301_receipt_subject
			has_variable = zg361_p3_m301_receipt_cycle
			has_variable = zg361_p3_m301_receipt_case
			has_variable = zg361_p3_m301_receipt_state
			has_variable = zg361_p3_m301_receipt_choice
			has_variable = zg361_p3_m301_debt_expected_due_cycle
			has_variable = zg361_p3_policy_debt_open_n
			has_variable = zg361_p3_policy_debt_settled_n
			root = {
				zg361_is_celestial_liege_trigger = yes
				has_variable = zg361_review_serial
			}
			zg361_is_reviewable_vassal_trigger = yes
			liege = root
			var:zg361_p3_m301_debt_status = 1
			var:zg361_p3_m301_debt_audit_state = 1
			var:zg361_p3_m301_debt_business_object_created = 0
			var:zg361_p3_m301_debt_mechanism = 301
			var:zg361_p3_policy_debt_open_n >= 1
			var:zg361_p3_m301_debt_owner = root
			var:zg361_p3_m301_debt_subject = this
		var:zg361_p3_m301_debt_owner = var:zg361_p3_m301_receipt_owner
		var:zg361_p3_m301_debt_subject = var:zg361_p3_m301_receipt_subject
		var:zg361_p3_m301_debt_cycle = var:zg361_p3_m301_receipt_cycle
		var:zg361_p3_m301_debt_case = var:zg361_p3_m301_receipt_case
		var:zg361_p3_m301_debt_state = var:zg361_p3_m301_receipt_state
			var:zg361_p3_m301_receipt_choice = 3
			var:zg361_p3_m301_debt_due_cycle = var:zg361_p3_m301_debt_expected_due_cycle
			root.var:zg361_review_serial = var:zg361_p3_m301_debt_due_cycle
		}
		var:zg361_p3_m301_debt_owner = {
			change_variable = { name = zg361_b2_management_debt add = 1 }
		}
		set_variable = { name = zg361_p3_m301_debt_status value = 2 }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_p3_m301_debt_audit_state value = 3 }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_p3_m301_debt_settled_by value = root }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_p3_m301_debt_settled_cycle value = root.var:zg361_review_serial }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_p3_m301_debt_performance_sink value = 1 }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_p3_m301_debt_consumer_status value = 1 }
		change_variable = { name = zg361_p3_policy_debt_open_n add = -1 }
		change_variable = { name = zg361_p3_policy_debt_settled_n add = 1 }
	}
	else_if = {
		# Exact settled replay is audit-only and never reaches the KPI sink again.
		limit = {
			has_variable = zg361_p3_m301_debt_owner
			has_variable = zg361_p3_m301_debt_subject
			has_variable = zg361_p3_m301_debt_status
			has_variable = zg361_p3_m301_debt_audit_state

			var:zg361_p3_m301_debt_subject = this
			var:zg361_p3_m301_debt_status = 2
			var:zg361_p3_m301_debt_audit_state = 3
			var:zg361_p3_m301_debt_settled_by = root
			root.var:zg361_review_serial >= var:zg361_p3_m301_debt_settled_cycle
		}
		set_variable = { name = zg361_p3_m301_debt_consumer_status value = 2 }
	}
	else_if = {
		# Complete exact input whose due cycle is later is future, never current work.
		limit = {
			has_variable = zg361_p3_m301_debt_owner
			has_variable = zg361_p3_m301_debt_subject
			has_variable = zg361_p3_m301_debt_cycle
			has_variable = zg361_p3_m301_debt_case
			has_variable = zg361_p3_m301_debt_state
			has_variable = zg361_p3_m301_debt_mechanism
			has_variable = zg361_p3_m301_debt_due_cycle
			has_variable = zg361_p3_m301_debt_status
			has_variable = zg361_p3_m301_debt_audit_state
			has_variable = zg361_p3_m301_debt_business_object_created
			has_variable = zg361_p3_m301_receipt_owner
			has_variable = zg361_p3_m301_receipt_subject
			has_variable = zg361_p3_m301_receipt_cycle
			has_variable = zg361_p3_m301_receipt_case
			has_variable = zg361_p3_m301_receipt_state
			has_variable = zg361_p3_m301_receipt_choice
			has_variable = zg361_p3_m301_debt_expected_due_cycle
			root = {
				zg361_is_celestial_liege_trigger = yes
				has_variable = zg361_review_serial
			}
			zg361_is_reviewable_vassal_trigger = yes
			liege = root
			var:zg361_p3_m301_debt_status = 1
			var:zg361_p3_m301_debt_audit_state = 1
			var:zg361_p3_m301_debt_business_object_created = 0
			var:zg361_p3_m301_debt_mechanism = 301
			var:zg361_p3_m301_debt_owner = root
			var:zg361_p3_m301_debt_subject = this
		var:zg361_p3_m301_debt_owner = var:zg361_p3_m301_receipt_owner
		var:zg361_p3_m301_debt_subject = var:zg361_p3_m301_receipt_subject
		var:zg361_p3_m301_debt_cycle = var:zg361_p3_m301_receipt_cycle
		var:zg361_p3_m301_debt_case = var:zg361_p3_m301_receipt_case
		var:zg361_p3_m301_debt_state = var:zg361_p3_m301_receipt_state
			var:zg361_p3_m301_receipt_choice = 3
			var:zg361_p3_m301_debt_due_cycle = var:zg361_p3_m301_debt_expected_due_cycle
			root.var:zg361_review_serial < var:zg361_p3_m301_debt_due_cycle
		}
		set_variable = { name = zg361_p3_m301_debt_consumer_status value = 5 }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_p3_policy_debt_consumer_blocked value = 1 }
	}
	else_if = {
		# Pending stale/cross-owner/corrupt identity: fail closed.
		limit = {
			OR = {
				trigger_if = {
					limit = { has_variable = zg361_p3_m301_debt_status }
					var:zg361_p3_m301_debt_status = 1
				}
				trigger_else = { always = no }
				trigger_if = {
					limit = { has_variable = zg361_p3_m301_receipt_choice }
					var:zg361_p3_m301_receipt_choice = 3
				}
				trigger_else = { always = no }
			}
		}
		set_variable = { name = zg361_p3_m301_debt_consumer_status value = 3 }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_p3_policy_debt_consumer_blocked value = 1 }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_p3_last_red_code value = 60301 }
	}
}

# #302 next-cycle route-C debt consumer.  The exact frozen
# owner receives the KPI sink; every other pending state blocks new lifecycle work.
zg361_p3_m302_consume_due_debt_effect = {
	remove_variable = zg361_p3_m302_debt_expected_due_cycle
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = zg361_p3_m302_debt_cycle }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_p3_m302_debt_expected_due_cycle value = var:zg361_p3_m302_debt_cycle }
		change_variable = { name = zg361_p3_m302_debt_expected_due_cycle add = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_variable = zg361_p3_m302_debt_owner
			has_variable = zg361_p3_m302_debt_subject
			has_variable = zg361_p3_m302_debt_cycle
			has_variable = zg361_p3_m302_debt_case
			has_variable = zg361_p3_m302_debt_state
			has_variable = zg361_p3_m302_debt_mechanism
			has_variable = zg361_p3_m302_debt_due_cycle
			has_variable = zg361_p3_m302_debt_status
			has_variable = zg361_p3_m302_debt_audit_state
			has_variable = zg361_p3_m302_debt_business_object_created
			has_variable = zg361_p3_m302_receipt_owner
			has_variable = zg361_p3_m302_receipt_subject
			has_variable = zg361_p3_m302_receipt_cycle
			has_variable = zg361_p3_m302_receipt_case
			has_variable = zg361_p3_m302_receipt_state
			has_variable = zg361_p3_m302_receipt_choice
			has_variable = zg361_p3_m302_debt_expected_due_cycle
			has_variable = zg361_p3_policy_debt_open_n
			has_variable = zg361_p3_policy_debt_settled_n
			root = {
				zg361_is_celestial_liege_trigger = yes
				has_variable = zg361_review_serial
			}
			zg361_is_reviewable_vassal_trigger = yes
			liege = root
			var:zg361_p3_m302_debt_status = 1
			var:zg361_p3_m302_debt_audit_state = 1
			var:zg361_p3_m302_debt_business_object_created = 0
			var:zg361_p3_m302_debt_mechanism = 302
			var:zg361_p3_policy_debt_open_n >= 1
			var:zg361_p3_m302_debt_owner = root
			var:zg361_p3_m302_debt_subject = this
		var:zg361_p3_m302_debt_owner = var:zg361_p3_m302_receipt_owner
		var:zg361_p3_m302_debt_subject = var:zg361_p3_m302_receipt_subject
		var:zg361_p3_m302_debt_cycle = var:zg361_p3_m302_receipt_cycle
		var:zg361_p3_m302_debt_case = var:zg361_p3_m302_receipt_case
		var:zg361_p3_m302_debt_state = var:zg361_p3_m302_receipt_state
			var:zg361_p3_m302_receipt_choice = 3
			var:zg361_p3_m302_debt_due_cycle = var:zg361_p3_m302_debt_expected_due_cycle
			root.var:zg361_review_serial = var:zg361_p3_m302_debt_due_cycle
		}
		var:zg361_p3_m302_debt_owner = {
			change_variable = { name = zg361_b2_management_debt add = 1 }
		}
		set_variable = { name = zg361_p3_m302_debt_status value = 2 }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_p3_m302_debt_audit_state value = 3 }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_p3_m302_debt_settled_by value = root }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_p3_m302_debt_settled_cycle value = root.var:zg361_review_serial }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_p3_m302_debt_performance_sink value = 1 }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_p3_m302_debt_consumer_status value = 1 }
		change_variable = { name = zg361_p3_policy_debt_open_n add = -1 }
		change_variable = { name = zg361_p3_policy_debt_settled_n add = 1 }
	}
	else_if = {
		# Exact settled replay is audit-only and never reaches the KPI sink again.
		limit = {
			has_variable = zg361_p3_m302_debt_owner
			has_variable = zg361_p3_m302_debt_subject
			has_variable = zg361_p3_m302_debt_status

		set_variable = { name = zg361_p3_m302_debt_consumer_status value = 2 }
	}
	else_if = {
		# Complete exact input whose due cycle is later is future, never current work.
		limit = {
			has_variable = zg361_p3_m302_debt_owner
			has_variable = zg361_p3_m302_debt_subject
			has_variable = zg361_p3_m302_debt_cycle

			has_variable = zg361_p3_m302_receipt_subject

			has_variable = zg361_p3_m302_receipt_state

		var:zg361_p3_m302_debt_subject = var:zg361_p3_m302_receipt_subject
		var:zg361_p3_m302_debt_cycle = var:zg361_p3_m302_receipt_cycle

		}
		set_variable = { name = zg361_p3_m302_debt_consumer_status value = 5 }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_p3_policy_debt_consumer_blocked value = 1 }
	}
	else_if = {
		# Pending stale/cross-owner/corrupt identity: fail closed.
		limit = {
			OR = {
				trigger_if = {
					limit = { has_variable = zg361_p3_m302_debt_status }
					var:zg361_p3_m302_debt_status = 1
				}
				trigger_else = { always = no }
				trigger_if = {
					limit = { has_variable = zg361_p3_m302_receipt_choice }

# #303 next-cycle route-C debt consumer.  The exact frozen
# owner receives the KPI sink; every other pending state blocks new lifecycle work.

		change_variable = { name = zg361_p3_m303_debt_expected_due_cycle add = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_variable = zg361_p3_m303_debt_owner
			has_variable = zg361_p3_m303_debt_subject

# #305 next-cycle route-C debt consumer.  The exact frozen
# owner receives the KPI sink; every other pending state blocks new lifecycle work.
zg361_p3_m305_consume_due_debt_effect = {
	remove_variable = zg361_p3_m305_debt_expected_due_cycle
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = zg361_p3_m305_debt_cycle }

	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_variable = zg361_p3_m305_debt_owner

		var:zg361_p3_m305_debt_subject = var:zg361_p3_m305_receipt_subject

			var:zg361_p3_m305_receipt_choice = 3
			var:zg361_p3_m305_debt_due_cycle = var:zg361_p3_m305_debt_expected_due_cycle
			root.var:zg361_review_serial < var:zg361_p3_m305_debt_due_cycle
		}
		set_variable = { name = zg361_p3_m305_debt_consumer_status value = 5 }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_p3_policy_debt_consumer_blocked value = 1 }
	}
	else_if = {

		set_variable = { name = zg361_p3_policy_debt_consumer_blocked value = 1 }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_p3_last_red_code value = 60305 }

# #306 next-cycle route-C debt consumer.  The exact frozen
# owner receives the KPI sink; every other pending state blocks new lifecycle work.
zg361_p3_m306_consume_due_debt_effect = {
	remove_variable = zg361_p3_m306_debt_expected_due_cycle
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = zg361_p3_m306_debt_cycle }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_p3_m306_debt_expected_due_cycle value = var:zg361_p3_m306_debt_cycle }
		change_variable = { name = zg361_p3_m306_debt_expected_due_cycle add = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_variable = zg361_p3_m306_debt_owner
			has_variable = zg361_p3_m306_debt_subject
			has_variable = zg361_p3_m306_debt_cycle
			has_variable = zg361_p3_m306_debt_case
			has_variable = zg361_p3_m306_debt_state
			has_variable = zg361_p3_m306_debt_mechanism
			has_variable = zg361_p3_m306_debt_due_cycle
			has_variable = zg361_p3_m306_debt_status
			has_variable = zg361_p3_m306_debt_audit_state
			has_variable = zg361_p3_m306_debt_business_object_created
			has_variable = zg361_p3_m306_receipt_owner
			has_variable = zg361_p3_m306_receipt_subject
			has_variable = zg361_p3_m306_receipt_cycle
			has_variable = zg361_p3_m306_receipt_case
			has_variable = zg361_p3_m306_receipt_state
			has_variable = zg361_p3_m306_receipt_choice
			has_variable = zg361_p3_m306_debt_expected_due_cycle
			has_variable = zg361_p3_policy_debt_open_n
			has_variable = zg361_p3_policy_debt_settled_n
			root = {
				zg361_is_celestial_liege_trigger = yes
				has_variable = zg361_review_serial
			}
			zg361_is_reviewable_vassal_trigger = yes
			liege = root
			var:zg361_p3_m306_debt_status = 1
			var:zg361_p3_m306_debt_audit_state = 1
			var:zg361_p3_m306_debt_business_object_created = 0
			var:zg361_p3_m306_debt_mechanism = 306
			var:zg361_p3_policy_debt_open_n >= 1
			var:zg361_p3_m306_debt_owner = root
			var:zg361_p3_m306_debt_subject = this
		var:zg361_p3_m306_debt_owner = var:zg361_p3_m306_receipt_owner
		var:zg361_p3_m306_debt_subject = var:zg361_p3_m306_receipt_subject
		var:zg361_p3_m306_debt_cycle = var:zg361_p3_m306_receipt_cycle
		var:zg361_p3_m306_debt_case = var:zg361_p3_m306_receipt_case
		var:zg361_p3_m306_debt_state = var:zg361_p3_m306_receipt_state
			var:zg361_p3_m306_receipt_choice = 3
			var:zg361_p3_m306_debt_due_cycle = var:zg361_p3_m306_debt_expected_due_cycle
			root.var:zg361_review_serial = var:zg361_p3_m306_debt_due_cycle
		}
		var:zg361_p3_m306_debt_owner = {
			change_variable = { name = zg361_b2_management_debt add = 1 }
		}
		set_variable = { name = zg361_p3_m306_debt_status value = 2 }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_p3_m306_debt_audit_state value = 3 }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_p3_m306_debt_settled_by value = root }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_p3_m306_debt_settled_cycle value = root.var:zg361_review_serial }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_p3_m306_debt_performance_sink value = 1 }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_p3_m306_debt_consumer_status value = 1 }
		change_variable = { name = zg361_p3_policy_debt_open_n add = -1 }
		change_variable = { name = zg361_p3_policy_debt_settled_n add = 1 }
	}
	else_if = {
		# Exact settled replay is audit-only and never reaches the KPI sink again.
		limit = {
			has_variable = zg361_p3_m306_debt_owner
			has_variable = zg361_p3_m306_debt_subject
			has_variable = zg361_p3_m306_debt_status

			var:zg361_p3_m306_debt_subject = this
			var:zg361_p3_m306_debt_status = 2
			var:zg361_p3_m306_debt_audit_state = 3
			var:zg361_p3_m306_debt_settled_by = root
			root.var:zg361_review_serial >= var:zg361_p3_m306_debt_settled_cycle
		}
		set_variable = { name = zg361_p3_m306_debt_consumer_status value = 2 }
	}
	else_if = {
		# Complete exact input whose due cycle is later is future, never current work.
		limit = {
			has_variable = zg361_p3_m306_debt_owner
			has_variable = zg361_p3_m306_debt_subject
			has_variable = zg361_p3_m306_debt_cycle
			has_variable = zg361_p3_m306_debt_case
			has_variable = zg361_p3_m306_debt_state
			has_variable = zg361_p3_m306_debt_mechanism
			has_variable = zg361_p3_m306_debt_due_cycle
			has_variable = zg361_p3_m306_debt_status
			has_variable = zg361_p3_m306_debt_audit_state
			has_variable = zg361_p3_m306_debt_business_object_created
			has_variable = zg361_p3_m306_receipt_owner
			has_variable = zg361_p3_m306_receipt_subject
			has_variable = zg361_p3_m306_receipt_cycle
			has_variable = zg361_p3_m306_receipt_case
			has_variable = zg361_p3_m306_receipt_state
			has_variable = zg361_p3_m306_receipt_choice
			has_variable = zg361_p3_m306_debt_expected_due_cycle
			root = {
				zg361_is_celestial_liege_trigger = yes
				has_variable = zg361_review_serial
			}
			zg361_is_reviewable_vassal_trigger = yes
			liege = root
			var:zg361_p3_m306_debt_status = 1
			var:zg361_p3_m306_debt_audit_state = 1
			var:zg361_p3_m306_debt_business_object_created = 0
			var:zg361_p3_m306_debt_mechanism = 306
			var:zg361_p3_m306_debt_owner = root
			var:zg361_p3_m306_debt_subject = this
		var:zg361_p3_m306_debt_owner = var:zg361_p3_m306_receipt_owner
		var:zg361_p3_m306_debt_subject = var:zg361_p3_m306_receipt_subject
		var:zg361_p3_m306_debt_cycle = var:zg361_p3_m306_receipt_cycle
		var:zg361_p3_m306_debt_case = var:zg361_p3_m306_receipt_case
		var:zg361_p3_m306_debt_state = var:zg361_p3_m306_receipt_state
			var:zg361_p3_m306_receipt_choice = 3
			var:zg361_p3_m306_debt_due_cycle = var:zg361_p3_m306_debt_expected_due_cycle
			root.var:zg361_review_serial < var:zg361_p3_m306_debt_due_cycle
		}
		set_variable = { name = zg361_p3_m306_debt_consumer_status value = 5 }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_p3_policy_debt_consumer_blocked value = 1 }
	}
	else_if = {
		# Pending stale/cross-owner/corrupt identity: fail closed.
		limit = {
			OR = {
				trigger_if = {
					limit = { has_variable = zg361_p3_m306_debt_status }
					var:zg361_p3_m306_debt_status = 1
				}
				trigger_else = { always = no }
				trigger_if = {
					limit = { has_variable = zg361_p3_m306_receipt_choice }
					var:zg361_p3_m306_receipt_choice = 3
				}
				trigger_else = { always = no }
			}
		}
		set_variable = { name = zg361_p3_m306_debt_consumer_status value = 3 }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_p3_policy_debt_consumer_blocked value = 1 }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_p3_last_red_code value = 60306 }
	}
}

# #307 next-cycle route-C debt consumer.  The exact frozen
# owner receives the KPI sink; every other pending state blocks new lifecycle work.
zg361_p3_m307_consume_due_debt_effect = {
	remove_variable = zg361_p3_m307_debt_expected_due_cycle
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = zg361_p3_m307_debt_cycle }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_p3_m307_debt_expected_due_cycle value = var:zg361_p3_m307_debt_cycle }
		change_variable = { name = zg361_p3_m307_debt_expected_due_cycle add = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_variable = zg361_p3_m307_debt_owner
			has_variable = zg361_p3_m307_debt_subject
			has_variable = zg361_p3_m307_debt_cycle
			has_variable = zg361_p3_m307_debt_case
			has_variable = zg361_p3_m307_debt_state
			has_variable = zg361_p3_m307_debt_mechanism
			has_variable = zg361_p3_m307_debt_due_cycle
			has_variable = zg361_p3_m307_debt_status
			has_variable = zg361_p3_m307_debt_audit_state
			has_variable = zg361_p3_m307_debt_business_object_created
			has_variable = zg361_p3_m307_receipt_owner
			has_variable = zg361_p3_m307_receipt_subject
			has_variable = zg361_p3_m307_receipt_cycle
			has_variable = zg361_p3_m307_receipt_case
			has_variable = zg361_p3_m307_receipt_state
			has_variable = zg361_p3_m307_receipt_choice
			has_variable = zg361_p3_m307_debt_expected_due_cycle
			has_variable = zg361_p3_policy_debt_open_n
			has_variable = zg361_p3_policy_debt_settled_n
			root = {
				zg361_is_celestial_liege_trigger = yes
				has_variable = zg361_review_serial
			}
			zg361_is_reviewable_vassal_trigger = yes
			liege = root
			var:zg361_p3_m307_debt_status = 1
			var:zg361_p3_m307_debt_audit_state = 1
			var:zg361_p3_m307_debt_business_object_created = 0
			var:zg361_p3_m307_debt_mechanism = 307
			var:zg361_p3_policy_debt_open_n >= 1
			var:zg361_p3_m307_debt_owner = root
			var:zg361_p3_m307_debt_subject = this
		var:zg361_p3_m307_debt_owner = var:zg361_p3_m307_receipt_owner
		var:zg361_p3_m307_debt_subject = var:zg361_p3_m307_receipt_subject
		var:zg361_p3_m307_debt_cycle = var:zg361_p3_m307_receipt_cycle
		var:zg361_p3_m307_debt_case = var:zg361_p3_m307_receipt_case
		var:zg361_p3_m307_debt_state = var:zg361_p3_m307_receipt_state
			var:zg361_p3_m307_receipt_choice = 3
			var:zg361_p3_m307_debt_due_cycle = var:zg361_p3_m307_debt_expected_due_cycle
			root.var:zg361_review_serial = var:zg361_p3_m307_debt_due_cycle
		}
		var:zg361_p3_m307_debt_owner = {
			change_variable = { name = zg361_b2_management_debt add = 1 }
		}
		set_variable = { name = zg361_p3_m307_debt_status value = 2 }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_p3_m307_debt_audit_state value = 3 }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_p3_m307_debt_settled_by value = root }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_p3_m307_debt_settled_cycle value = root.var:zg361_review_serial }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_p3_m307_debt_performance_sink value = 1 }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_p3_m307_debt_consumer_status value = 1 }
		change_variable = { name = zg361_p3_policy_debt_open_n add = -1 }
		change_variable = { name = zg361_p3_policy_debt_settled_n add = 1 }
	}
	else_if = {
		# Exact settled replay is audit-only and never reaches the KPI sink again.
		limit = {

		set_variable = { name = zg361_p3_m307_debt_consumer_status value = 2 }
	}
	else_if = {
		# Complete exact input whose due cycle is later is future, never current work.
		limit = {
			has_variable = zg361_p3_m307_debt_owner
			has_variable = zg361_p3_m307_debt_subject
			has_variable = zg361_p3_m307_debt_cycle

			has_variable = zg361_p3_m307_receipt_subject
			has_variable = zg361_p3_m307_receipt_cycle
			has_variable = zg361_p3_m307_receipt_case

		var:zg361_p3_m307_debt_subject = var:zg361_p3_m307_receipt_subject
		var:zg361_p3_m307_debt_cycle = var:zg361_p3_m307_receipt_cycle

		var:zg361_p3_m307_debt_state = var:zg361_p3_m307_receipt_state
			var:zg361_p3_m307_receipt_choice = 3

			root.var:zg361_review_serial < var:zg361_p3_m307_debt_due_cycle
		}
		set_variable = { name = zg361_p3_m307_debt_consumer_status value = 5 }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_p3_policy_debt_consumer_blocked value = 1 }
	}
	else_if = {
		# Pending stale/cross-owner/corrupt identity: fail closed.
		limit = {
			OR = {
				trigger_if = {
					limit = { has_variable = zg361_p3_m307_debt_status }
					var:zg361_p3_m307_debt_status = 1
				}
				trigger_else = { always = no }

					limit = { has_variable = zg361_p3_m307_receipt_choice }

		}
		set_variable = { name = zg361_p3_m307_debt_consumer_status value = 3 }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_p3_policy_debt_consumer_blocked value = 1 }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_p3_last_red_code value = 60307 }
	}

# #308 next-cycle route-C debt consumer.  The exact frozen
# owner receives the KPI sink; every other pending state blocks new lifecycle work.
zg361_p3_m308_consume_due_debt_effect = {
	remove_variable = zg361_p3_m308_debt_expected_due_cycle
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = zg361_p3_m308_debt_cycle }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_p3_m308_debt_expected_due_cycle value = var:zg361_p3_m308_debt_cycle }
		change_variable = { name = zg361_p3_m308_debt_expected_due_cycle add = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_variable = zg361_p3_m308_debt_owner
			has_variable = zg361_p3_m308_debt_subject
			has_variable = zg361_p3_m308_debt_cycle

			liege = root

			var:zg361_p3_m308_debt_audit_state = 1

		change_variable = { name = zg361_p3_policy_debt_settled_n add = 1 }

	else_if = {

			root.var:zg361_review_serial >= var:zg361_p3_m308_debt_settled_cycle
		}
		set_variable = { name = zg361_p3_m308_debt_consumer_status value = 2 }
	}
	else_if = {
		# Complete exact input whose due cycle is later is future, never current work.
		limit = {
			has_variable = zg361_p3_m308_debt_owner
			has_variable = zg361_p3_m308_debt_subject
			has_variable = zg361_p3_m308_debt_cycle
			has_variable = zg361_p3_m308_debt_case

			has_variable = zg361_p3_m308_debt_audit_state
			has_variable = zg361_p3_m308_debt_business_object_created
			has_variable = zg361_p3_m308_receipt_owner
			has_variable = zg361_p3_m308_receipt_subject
			has_variable = zg361_p3_m308_receipt_cycle
			has_variable = zg361_p3_m308_receipt_case
			has_variable = zg361_p3_m308_receipt_state
			has_variable = zg361_p3_m308_receipt_choice

			}

			var:zg361_p3_m308_debt_status = 1
			var:zg361_p3_m308_debt_audit_state = 1

			var:zg361_p3_m308_debt_mechanism = 308
			var:zg361_p3_m308_debt_owner = root
			var:zg361_p3_m308_debt_subject = this
		var:zg361_p3_m308_debt_owner = var:zg361_p3_m308_receipt_owner
		var:zg361_p3_m308_debt_subject = var:zg361_p3_m308_receipt_subject
		var:zg361_p3_m308_debt_cycle = var:zg361_p3_m308_receipt_cycle
		var:zg361_p3_m308_debt_case = var:zg361_p3_m308_receipt_case
		var:zg361_p3_m308_debt_state = var:zg361_p3_m308_receipt_state
			var:zg361_p3_m308_receipt_choice = 3

			root.var:zg361_review_serial < var:zg361_p3_m308_debt_due_cycle
		}
		set_variable = { name = zg361_p3_m308_debt_consumer_status value = 5 }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_p3_policy_debt_consumer_blocked value = 1 }
	}
	else_if = {
		# Pending stale/cross-owner/corrupt identity: fail closed.
		limit = {
			OR = {
				trigger_if = {
					limit = { has_variable = zg361_p3_m308_debt_status }
					var:zg361_p3_m308_debt_status = 1
				}
				trigger_else = { always = no }
				trigger_if = {
					limit = { has_variable = zg361_p3_m308_receipt_choice }
					var:zg361_p3_m308_receipt_choice = 3

		set_variable = { name = zg361_p3_policy_debt_consumer_blocked value = 1 }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_p3_last_red_code value = 60308 }
	}
}

# #310 next-cycle route-C debt consumer.  The exact frozen
# owner receives the KPI sink; every other pending state blocks new lifecycle work.
zg361_p3_m310_consume_due_debt_effect = {
	remove_variable = zg361_p3_m310_debt_expected_due_cycle
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = zg361_p3_m310_debt_cycle }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_p3_m310_debt_expected_due_cycle value = var:zg361_p3_m310_debt_cycle }
		change_variable = { name = zg361_p3_m310_debt_expected_due_cycle add = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_variable = zg361_p3_m310_debt_owner
			has_variable = zg361_p3_m310_debt_subject
			has_variable = zg361_p3_m310_debt_cycle
			has_variable = zg361_p3_m310_debt_case
			has_variable = zg361_p3_m310_debt_state

			has_variable = zg361_p3_m310_debt_audit_state
			has_variable = zg361_p3_m310_debt_business_object_created
			has_variable = zg361_p3_m310_receipt_owner
			has_variable = zg361_p3_m310_receipt_subject
			has_variable = zg361_p3_m310_receipt_cycle
			has_variable = zg361_p3_m310_receipt_case
			has_variable = zg361_p3_m310_receipt_state
			has_variable = zg361_p3_m310_receipt_choice
			has_variable = zg361_p3_m310_debt_expected_due_cycle
			has_variable = zg361_p3_policy_debt_open_n
			has_variable = zg361_p3_policy_debt_settled_n
			root = {
				zg361_is_celestial_liege_trigger = yes
				has_variable = zg361_review_serial
			}
			zg361_is_reviewable_vassal_trigger = yes
			liege = root
			var:zg361_p3_m310_debt_status = 1
			var:zg361_p3_m310_debt_audit_state = 1
			var:zg361_p3_m310_debt_business_object_created = 0
			var:zg361_p3_m310_debt_mechanism = 310
			var:zg361_p3_policy_debt_open_n >= 1
			var:zg361_p3_m310_debt_owner = root
			var:zg361_p3_m310_debt_subject = this
		var:zg361_p3_m310_debt_owner = var:zg361_p3_m310_receipt_owner
		var:zg361_p3_m310_debt_subject = var:zg361_p3_m310_receipt_subject
		var:zg361_p3_m310_debt_cycle = var:zg361_p3_m310_receipt_cycle
		var:zg361_p3_m310_debt_case = var:zg361_p3_m310_receipt_case
		var:zg361_p3_m310_debt_state = var:zg361_p3_m310_receipt_state
			var:zg361_p3_m310_receipt_choice = 3
			var:zg361_p3_m310_debt_due_cycle = var:zg361_p3_m310_debt_expected_due_cycle
			root.var:zg361_review_serial = var:zg361_p3_m310_debt_due_cycle
		}
		var:zg361_p3_m310_debt_owner = {
			change_variable = { name = zg361_b2_management_debt add = 1 }
		}
		set_variable = { name = zg361_p3_m310_debt_status value = 2 }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_p3_m310_debt_audit_state value = 3 }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_p3_m310_debt_settled_by value = root }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_p3_m310_debt_settled_cycle value = root.var:zg361_review_serial }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_p3_m310_debt_performance_sink value = 1 }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_p3_m310_debt_consumer_status value = 1 }
		change_variable = { name = zg361_p3_policy_debt_open_n add = -1 }
		change_variable = { name = zg361_p3_policy_debt_settled_n add = 1 }
	}
	else_if = {
		# Exact settled replay is audit-only and never reaches the KPI sink again.
		limit = {
			has_variable = zg361_p3_m310_debt_owner
			has_variable = zg361_p3_m310_debt_subject
			has_variable = zg361_p3_m310_debt_status

			var:zg361_p3_m310_debt_status = 2
			var:zg361_p3_m310_debt_audit_state = 3
			var:zg361_p3_m310_debt_settled_by = root
			root.var:zg361_review_serial >= var:zg361_p3_m310_debt_settled_cycle
		}
		set_variable = { name = zg361_p3_m310_debt_consumer_status value = 2 }
	}
	else_if = {
		# Complete exact input whose due cycle is later is future, never current work.
		limit = {
			has_variable = zg361_p3_m310_debt_owner
			has_variable = zg361_p3_m310_debt_subject
			has_variable = zg361_p3_m310_debt_cycle
			has_variable = zg361_p3_m310_debt_case
			has_variable = zg361_p3_m310_debt_state
			has_variable = zg361_p3_m310_debt_mechanism
			has_variable = zg361_p3_m310_debt_due_cycle
			has_variable = zg361_p3_m310_debt_status
			has_variable = zg361_p3_m310_debt_audit_state
			has_variable = zg361_p3_m310_debt_business_object_created
			has_variable = zg361_p3_m310_receipt_owner
			has_variable = zg361_p3_m310_receipt_subject
			has_variable = zg361_p3_m310_receipt_cycle
			has_variable = zg361_p3_m310_receipt_case
			has_variable = zg361_p3_m310_receipt_state
			has_variable = zg361_p3_m310_receipt_choice
			has_variable = zg361_p3_m310_debt_expected_due_cycle
			root = {
				zg361_is_celestial_liege_trigger = yes
				has_variable = zg361_review_serial
			}
			zg361_is_reviewable_vassal_trigger = yes
			liege = root
			var:zg361_p3_m310_debt_status = 1
			var:zg361_p3_m310_debt_audit_state = 1
			var:zg361_p3_m310_debt_business_object_created = 0
			var:zg361_p3_m310_debt_mechanism = 310
			var:zg361_p3_m310_debt_owner = root
			var:zg361_p3_m310_debt_subject = this
		var:zg361_p3_m310_debt_owner = var:zg361_p3_m310_receipt_owner
		var:zg361_p3_m310_debt_subject = var:zg361_p3_m310_receipt_subject
		var:zg361_p3_m310_debt_cycle = var:zg361_p3_m310_receipt_cycle
		var:zg361_p3_m310_debt_case = var:zg361_p3_m310_receipt_case
		var:zg361_p3_m310_debt_state = var:zg361_p3_m310_receipt_state
			var:zg361_p3_m310_receipt_choice = 3
			var:zg361_p3_m310_debt_due_cycle = var:zg361_p3_m310_debt_expected_due_cycle
			root.var:zg361_review_serial < var:zg361_p3_m310_debt_due_cycle
		}
		set_variable = { name = zg361_p3_m310_debt_consumer_status value = 5 }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_p3_policy_debt_consumer_blocked value = 1 }
	}
	else_if = {
		# Pending stale/cross-owner/corrupt identity: fail closed.
		limit = {
			OR = {
				trigger_if = {
					limit = { has_variable = zg361_p3_m310_debt_status }
					var:zg361_p3_m310_debt_status = 1
				}
				trigger_else = { always = no }
				trigger_if = {
					limit = { has_variable = zg361_p3_m310_receipt_choice }
					var:zg361_p3_m310_receipt_choice = 3
				}
				trigger_else = { always = no }
			}
		}
		set_variable = { name = zg361_p3_m310_debt_consumer_status value = 3 }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_p3_policy_debt_consumer_blocked value = 1 }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_p3_last_red_code value = 60310 }
	}
}

# #311 next-cycle route-C debt consumer.  The exact frozen
# owner receives the KPI sink; every other pending state blocks new lifecycle work.
zg361_p3_m311_consume_due_debt_effect = {
	remove_variable = zg361_p3_m311_debt_expected_due_cycle
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = zg361_p3_m311_debt_cycle }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_p3_m311_debt_expected_due_cycle value = var:zg361_p3_m311_debt_cycle }
		change_variable = { name = zg361_p3_m311_debt_expected_due_cycle add = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_variable = zg361_p3_m311_debt_owner
			has_variable = zg361_p3_m311_debt_subject

			has_variable = zg361_p3_policy_debt_open_n
			has_variable = zg361_p3_policy_debt_settled_n
			root = {
				zg361_is_celestial_liege_trigger = yes
				has_variable = zg361_review_serial
			}

			liege = root
			var:zg361_p3_m311_debt_status = 1
			var:zg361_p3_m311_debt_audit_state = 1
			var:zg361_p3_m311_debt_business_object_created = 0

			var:zg361_p3_policy_debt_open_n >= 1
			var:zg361_p3_m311_debt_owner = root
			var:zg361_p3_m311_debt_subject = this
		var:zg361_p3_m311_debt_owner = var:zg361_p3_m311_receipt_owner
		var:zg361_p3_m311_debt_subject = var:zg361_p3_m311_receipt_subject

			root.var:zg361_review_serial = var:zg361_p3_m311_debt_due_cycle

		}
		set_variable = { name = zg361_p3_m311_debt_status value = 2 }

		set_variable = { name = zg361_p3_m311_debt_settled_cycle value = root.var:zg361_review_serial }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_p3_m311_debt_performance_sink value = 1 }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_p3_m311_debt_consumer_status value = 1 }
		change_variable = { name = zg361_p3_policy_debt_open_n add = -1 }
		change_variable = { name = zg361_p3_policy_debt_settled_n add = 1 }
	}
	else_if = {
		# Exact settled replay is audit-only and never reaches the KPI sink again.
		limit = {

			root.var:zg361_review_serial >= var:zg361_p3_m311_debt_settled_cycle
		}
		set_variable = { name = zg361_p3_m311_debt_consumer_status value = 2 }
	}
	else_if = {
		# Complete exact input whose due cycle is later is future, never current work.
		limit = {
			has_variable = zg361_p3_m311_debt_owner
			has_variable = zg361_p3_m311_debt_subject
			has_variable = zg361_p3_m311_debt_cycle

			has_variable = zg361_p3_m311_debt_audit_state
			has_variable = zg361_p3_m311_debt_business_object_created
			has_variable = zg361_p3_m311_receipt_owner
			has_variable = zg361_p3_m311_receipt_subject
			has_variable = zg361_p3_m311_receipt_cycle
			has_variable = zg361_p3_m311_receipt_case
			has_variable = zg361_p3_m311_receipt_state
			has_variable = zg361_p3_m311_receipt_choice

			liege = root
			var:zg361_p3_m311_debt_status = 1
			var:zg361_p3_m311_debt_audit_state = 1

			var:zg361_p3_m311_debt_mechanism = 311
			var:zg361_p3_m311_debt_owner = root
			var:zg361_p3_m311_debt_subject = this
		var:zg361_p3_m311_debt_owner = var:zg361_p3_m311_receipt_owner
		var:zg361_p3_m311_debt_subject = var:zg361_p3_m311_receipt_subject
		var:zg361_p3_m311_debt_cycle = var:zg361_p3_m311_receipt_cycle
		var:zg361_p3_m311_debt_case = var:zg361_p3_m311_receipt_case
		var:zg361_p3_m311_debt_state = var:zg361_p3_m311_receipt_state
			var:zg361_p3_m311_receipt_choice = 3
			var:zg361_p3_m311_debt_due_cycle = var:zg361_p3_m311_debt_expected_due_cycle
			root.var:zg361_review_serial < var:zg361_p3_m311_debt_due_cycle
		}
		set_variable = { name = zg361_p3_m311_debt_consumer_status value = 5 }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_p3_policy_debt_consumer_blocked value = 1 }
	}
	else_if = {
		# Pending stale/cross-owner/corrupt identity: fail closed.
		limit = {
			OR = {
				trigger_if = {
					limit = { has_variable = zg361_p3_m311_debt_status }
					var:zg361_p3_m311_debt_status = 1
				}
				trigger_else = { always = no }
				trigger_if = {
					limit = { has_variable = zg361_p3_m311_receipt_choice }
					var:zg361_p3_m311_receipt_choice = 3
				}
				trigger_else = { always = no }
			}
		}
		set_variable = { name = zg361_p3_m311_debt_consumer_status value = 3 }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_p3_policy_debt_consumer_blocked value = 1 }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_p3_last_red_code value = 60311 }
	}
}

# #334 next-cycle route-C debt consumer.  The exact frozen
# owner receives the KPI sink; every other pending state blocks new lifecycle work.
zg361_p3_m334_consume_due_debt_effect = {
	remove_variable = zg361_p3_m334_debt_expected_due_cycle
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = zg361_p3_m334_debt_cycle }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_p3_m334_debt_expected_due_cycle value = var:zg361_p3_m334_debt_cycle }
		change_variable = { name = zg361_p3_m334_debt_expected_due_cycle add = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_variable = zg361_p3_m334_debt_owner
			has_variable = zg361_p3_m334_debt_subject
			has_variable = zg361_p3_m334_debt_cycle

			has_variable = zg361_p3_m334_receipt_subject

			has_variable = zg361_p3_m334_receipt_choice
			has_variable = zg361_p3_m334_debt_expected_due_cycle
			has_variable = zg361_p3_policy_debt_open_n
			has_variable = zg361_p3_policy_debt_settled_n
			root = {
				zg361_is_celestial_liege_trigger = yes
				has_variable = zg361_review_serial
			}
			zg361_is_reviewable_vassal_trigger = yes
			liege = root
			var:zg361_p3_m334_debt_status = 1
			var:zg361_p3_m334_debt_audit_state = 1
			var:zg361_p3_m334_debt_business_object_created = 0
			var:zg361_p3_m334_debt_mechanism = 334
			var:zg361_p3_policy_debt_open_n >= 1
			var:zg361_p3_m334_debt_owner = root
			var:zg361_p3_m334_debt_subject = this
		var:zg361_p3_m334_debt_owner = var:zg361_p3_m334_receipt_owner
		var:zg361_p3_m334_debt_subject = var:zg361_p3_m334_receipt_subject
		var:zg361_p3_m334_debt_cycle = var:zg361_p3_m334_receipt_cycle

			var:zg361_p3_m334_receipt_choice = 3
			var:zg361_p3_m334_debt_due_cycle = var:zg361_p3_m334_debt_expected_due_cycle
			root.var:zg361_review_serial = var:zg361_p3_m334_debt_due_cycle
		}
		var:zg361_p3_m334_debt_owner = {
			change_variable = { name = zg361_b2_management_debt add = 1 }
		}
		set_variable = { name = zg361_p3_m334_debt_status value = 2 }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_p3_m334_debt_audit_state value = 3 }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_p3_m334_debt_settled_by value = root }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_p3_m334_debt_settled_cycle value = root.var:zg361_review_serial }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_p3_m334_debt_performance_sink value = 1 }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_p3_m334_debt_consumer_status value = 1 }
		change_variable = { name = zg361_p3_policy_debt_open_n add = -1 }
		change_variable = { name = zg361_p3_policy_debt_settled_n add = 1 }
	}
	else_if = {
		# Exact settled replay is audit-only and never reaches the KPI sink again.
		limit = {
			has_variable = zg361_p3_m334_debt_owner
			has_variable = zg361_p3_m334_debt_subject
			has_variable = zg361_p3_m334_debt_status

			var:zg361_p3_m334_debt_settled_by = root
			root.var:zg361_review_serial >= var:zg361_p3_m334_debt_settled_cycle
		}
		set_variable = { name = zg361_p3_m334_debt_consumer_status value = 2 }
	}
	else_if = {
		# Complete exact input whose due cycle is later is future, never current work.
		limit = {
			has_variable = zg361_p3_m334_debt_owner
			has_variable = zg361_p3_m334_debt_subject
			has_variable = zg361_p3_m334_debt_cycle
			has_variable = zg361_p3_m334_debt_case
			has_variable = zg361_p3_m334_debt_state
			has_variable = zg361_p3_m334_debt_mechanism
			has_variable = zg361_p3_m334_debt_due_cycle
			has_variable = zg361_p3_m334_debt_status
			has_variable = zg361_p3_m334_debt_audit_state
			has_variable = zg361_p3_m334_debt_business_object_created
			has_variable = zg361_p3_m334_receipt_owner
			has_variable = zg361_p3_m334_receipt_subject
			has_variable = zg361_p3_m334_receipt_cycle
			has_variable = zg361_p3_m334_receipt_case
			has_variable = zg361_p3_m334_receipt_state
			has_variable = zg361_p3_m334_receipt_choice

				zg361_is_celestial_liege_trigger = yes

			}

			liege = root
			var:zg361_p3_m334_debt_status = 1
			var:zg361_p3_m334_debt_audit_state = 1
			var:zg361_p3_m334_debt_business_object_created = 0
			var:zg361_p3_m334_debt_mechanism = 334
			var:zg361_p3_m334_debt_owner = root
			var:zg361_p3_m334_debt_subject = this
		var:zg361_p3_m334_debt_owner = var:zg361_p3_m334_receipt_owner
		var:zg361_p3_m334_debt_subject = var:zg361_p3_m334_receipt_subject
		var:zg361_p3_m334_debt_cycle = var:zg361_p3_m334_receipt_cycle
		var:zg361_p3_m334_debt_case = var:zg361_p3_m334_receipt_case
		var:zg361_p3_m334_debt_state = var:zg361_p3_m334_receipt_state
			var:zg361_p3_m334_receipt_choice = 3
			var:zg361_p3_m334_debt_due_cycle = var:zg361_p3_m334_debt_expected_due_cycle
			root.var:zg361_review_serial < var:zg361_p3_m334_debt_due_cycle
		}
		set_variable = { name = zg361_p3_m334_debt_consumer_status value = 5 }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_p3_policy_debt_consumer_blocked value = 1 }
	}
	else_if = {
		# Pending stale/cross-owner/corrupt identity: fail closed.
		limit = {
			OR = {
				trigger_if = {
					limit = { has_variable = zg361_p3_m334_debt_status }
					var:zg361_p3_m334_debt_status = 1
				}
				trigger_else = { always = no }
				trigger_if = {
					limit = { has_variable = zg361_p3_m334_receipt_choice }
					var:zg361_p3_m334_receipt_choice = 3
				}
				trigger_else = { always = no }
			}
		}
		set_variable = { name = zg361_p3_m334_debt_consumer_status value = 3 }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_p3_policy_debt_consumer_blocked value = 1 }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_p3_last_red_code value = 60334 }
	}
}

# #335 next-cycle route-C debt consumer.  The exact frozen
# owner receives the KPI sink; every other pending state blocks new lifecycle work.
zg361_p3_m335_consume_due_debt_effect = {
	remove_variable = zg361_p3_m335_debt_expected_due_cycle
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = zg361_p3_m335_debt_cycle }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_p3_m335_debt_expected_due_cycle value = var:zg361_p3_m335_debt_cycle }
		change_variable = { name = zg361_p3_m335_debt_expected_due_cycle add = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_variable = zg361_p3_m335_debt_owner
			has_variable = zg361_p3_m335_debt_subject
			has_variable = zg361_p3_m335_debt_cycle
			has_variable = zg361_p3_m335_debt_case
			has_variable = zg361_p3_m335_debt_state
			has_variable = zg361_p3_m335_debt_mechanism
			has_variable = zg361_p3_m335_debt_due_cycle
			has_variable = zg361_p3_m335_debt_status
			has_variable = zg361_p3_m335_debt_audit_state
			has_variable = zg361_p3_m335_debt_business_object_created
			has_variable = zg361_p3_m335_receipt_owner
			has_variable = zg361_p3_m335_receipt_subject
			has_variable = zg361_p3_m335_receipt_cycle
			has_variable = zg361_p3_m335_receipt_case
			has_variable = zg361_p3_m335_receipt_state
			has_variable = zg361_p3_m335_receipt_choice
			has_variable = zg361_p3_m335_debt_expected_due_cycle
			has_variable = zg361_p3_policy_debt_open_n
			has_variable = zg361_p3_policy_debt_settled_n
			root = {
				zg361_is_celestial_liege_trigger = yes
				has_variable = zg361_review_serial
			}
			zg361_is_reviewable_vassal_trigger = yes
			liege = root
			var:zg361_p3_m335_debt_status = 1
			var:zg361_p3_m335_debt_audit_state = 1
			var:zg361_p3_m335_debt_business_object_created = 0
			var:zg361_p3_m335_debt_mechanism = 335
			var:zg361_p3_policy_debt_open_n >= 1
			var:zg361_p3_m335_debt_owner = root
			var:zg361_p3_m335_debt_subject = this
		var:zg361_p3_m335_debt_owner = var:zg361_p3_m335_receipt_owner
		var:zg361_p3_m335_debt_subject = var:zg361_p3_m335_receipt_subject
		var:zg361_p3_m335_debt_cycle = var:zg361_p3_m335_receipt_cycle
		var:zg361_p3_m335_debt_case = var:zg361_p3_m335_receipt_case
		var:zg361_p3_m335_debt_state = var:zg361_p3_m335_receipt_state
			var:zg361_p3_m335_receipt_choice = 3
			var:zg361_p3_m335_debt_due_cycle = var:zg361_p3_m335_debt_expected_due_cycle
			root.var:zg361_review_serial = var:zg361_p3_m335_debt_due_cycle
		}
		var:zg361_p3_m335_debt_owner = {
			change_variable = { name = zg361_b2_management_debt add = 1 }
		}
		set_variable = { name = zg361_p3_m335_debt_status value = 2 }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_p3_m335_debt_audit_state value = 3 }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_p3_m335_debt_settled_by value = root }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_p3_m335_debt_settled_cycle value = root.var:zg361_review_serial }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_p3_m335_debt_performance_sink value = 1 }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_p3_m335_debt_consumer_status value = 1 }
		change_variable = { name = zg361_p3_policy_debt_open_n add = -1 }
		change_variable = { name = zg361_p3_policy_debt_settled_n add = 1 }
	}
	else_if = {
		# Exact settled replay is audit-only and never reaches the KPI sink again.
		limit = {
			has_variable = zg361_p3_m335_debt_owner
			has_variable = zg361_p3_m335_debt_subject
			has_variable = zg361_p3_m335_debt_status
			has_variable = zg361_p3_m335_debt_audit_state
			has_variable = zg361_p3_m335_debt_settled_by
			has_variable = zg361_p3_m335_debt_settled_cycle
			root = {
				zg361_is_celestial_liege_trigger = yes
				has_variable = zg361_review_serial
			}
			zg361_is_reviewable_vassal_trigger = yes
			liege = root
			var:zg361_p3_m335_debt_owner = root
			var:zg361_p3_m335_debt_subject = this
			var:zg361_p3_m335_debt_status = 2
			var:zg361_p3_m335_debt_audit_state = 3
			var:zg361_p3_m335_debt_settled_by = root
			root.var:zg361_review_serial >= var:zg361_p3_m335_debt_settled_cycle
		}
		set_variable = { name = zg361_p3_m335_debt_consumer_status value = 2 }
	}
	else_if = {
		# Complete exact input whose due cycle is later is future, never current work.
		limit = {
			has_variable = zg361_p3_m335_debt_owner
			has_variable = zg361_p3_m335_debt_subject
			has_variable = zg361_p3_m335_debt_cycle
			has_variable = zg361_p3_m335_debt_case
			has_variable = zg361_p3_m335_debt_state

# owner receives the KPI sink; every other pending state blocks new lifecycle work.

	if = {
		limit = {
			has_variable = zg361_p3_m339_debt_owner

# #340 next-cycle route-C debt consumer.  The exact frozen
# owner receives the KPI sink; every other pending state blocks new lifecycle work.
zg361_p3_m340_consume_due_debt_effect = {
	remove_variable = zg361_p3_m340_debt_expected_due_cycle
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = zg361_p3_m340_debt_cycle }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_p3_m340_debt_expected_due_cycle value = var:zg361_p3_m340_debt_cycle }
		change_variable = { name = zg361_p3_m340_debt_expected_due_cycle add = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_variable = zg361_p3_m340_debt_owner
			has_variable = zg361_p3_m340_debt_subject
			has_variable = zg361_p3_m340_debt_cycle
			has_variable = zg361_p3_m340_debt_case
			has_variable = zg361_p3_m340_debt_state
			has_variable = zg361_p3_m340_debt_mechanism
			has_variable = zg361_p3_m340_debt_due_cycle
			has_variable = zg361_p3_m340_debt_status
			has_variable = zg361_p3_m340_debt_audit_state
			has_variable = zg361_p3_m340_debt_business_object_created
			has_variable = zg361_p3_m340_receipt_owner
			has_variable = zg361_p3_m340_receipt_subject
			has_variable = zg361_p3_m340_receipt_cycle
			has_variable = zg361_p3_m340_receipt_case
			has_variable = zg361_p3_m340_receipt_state
			has_variable = zg361_p3_m340_receipt_choice
			has_variable = zg361_p3_m340_debt_expected_due_cycle
			has_variable = zg361_p3_policy_debt_open_n
			has_variable = zg361_p3_policy_debt_settled_n
			root = {
				zg361_is_celestial_liege_trigger = yes
				has_variable = zg361_review_serial
			}
			zg361_is_reviewable_vassal_trigger = yes
			liege = root
			var:zg361_p3_m340_debt_status = 1
			var:zg361_p3_m340_debt_audit_state = 1
			var:zg361_p3_m340_debt_business_object_created = 0
			var:zg361_p3_m340_debt_mechanism = 340
			var:zg361_p3_policy_debt_open_n >= 1

			var:zg361_p3_m340_debt_subject = this
		var:zg361_p3_m340_debt_owner = var:zg361_p3_m340_receipt_owner
		var:zg361_p3_m340_debt_subject = var:zg361_p3_m340_receipt_subject
		var:zg361_p3_m340_debt_cycle = var:zg361_p3_m340_receipt_cycle
		var:zg361_p3_m340_debt_case = var:zg361_p3_m340_receipt_case
		var:zg361_p3_m340_debt_state = var:zg361_p3_m340_receipt_state

# #342 next-cycle route-C debt consumer.  The exact frozen
# owner receives the KPI sink; every other pending state blocks new lifecycle work.
zg361_p3_m342_consume_due_debt_effect = {
	remove_variable = zg361_p3_m342_debt_expected_due_cycle
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = zg361_p3_m342_debt_cycle }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_p3_m342_debt_expected_due_cycle value = var:zg361_p3_m342_debt_cycle }
		change_variable = { name = zg361_p3_m342_debt_expected_due_cycle add = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_variable = zg361_p3_m342_debt_owner
			has_variable = zg361_p3_m342_debt_subject
			has_variable = zg361_p3_m342_debt_cycle
			has_variable = zg361_p3_m342_debt_case
			has_variable = zg361_p3_m342_debt_state
			has_variable = zg361_p3_m342_debt_mechanism
			has_variable = zg361_p3_m342_debt_due_cycle
			has_variable = zg361_p3_m342_debt_status
			has_variable = zg361_p3_m342_debt_audit_state
			has_variable = zg361_p3_m342_debt_business_object_created
			has_variable = zg361_p3_m342_receipt_owner
			has_variable = zg361_p3_m342_receipt_subject
			has_variable = zg361_p3_m342_receipt_cycle
			has_variable = zg361_p3_m342_receipt_case
			has_variable = zg361_p3_m342_receipt_state
			has_variable = zg361_p3_m342_receipt_choice
			has_variable = zg361_p3_m342_debt_expected_due_cycle
			has_variable = zg361_p3_policy_debt_open_n
			has_variable = zg361_p3_policy_debt_settled_n
			root = {
				zg361_is_celestial_liege_trigger = yes
				has_variable = zg361_review_serial
			}
			zg361_is_reviewable_vassal_trigger = yes
			liege = root
			var:zg361_p3_m342_debt_status = 1
			var:zg361_p3_m342_debt_audit_state = 1
			var:zg361_p3_m342_debt_business_object_created = 0
			var:zg361_p3_m342_debt_mechanism = 342
			var:zg361_p3_policy_debt_open_n >= 1
			var:zg361_p3_m342_debt_owner = root
			var:zg361_p3_m342_debt_subject = this
		var:zg361_p3_m342_debt_owner = var:zg361_p3_m342_receipt_owner
		var:zg361_p3_m342_debt_subject = var:zg361_p3_m342_receipt_subject
		var:zg361_p3_m342_debt_cycle = var:zg361_p3_m342_receipt_cycle
		var:zg361_p3_m342_debt_case = var:zg361_p3_m342_receipt_case
		var:zg361_p3_m342_debt_state = var:zg361_p3_m342_receipt_state
			var:zg361_p3_m342_receipt_choice = 3
			var:zg361_p3_m342_debt_due_cycle = var:zg361_p3_m342_debt_expected_due_cycle
			root.var:zg361_review_serial = var:zg361_p3_m342_debt_due_cycle
		}
		var:zg361_p3_m342_debt_owner = {
			change_variable = { name = zg361_b2_management_debt add = 1 }
		}
		set_variable = { name = zg361_p3_m342_debt_status value = 2 }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_p3_m342_debt_audit_state value = 3 }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_p3_m342_debt_settled_by value = root }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_p3_m342_debt_settled_cycle value = root.var:zg361_review_serial }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_p3_m342_debt_performance_sink value = 1 }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_p3_m342_debt_consumer_status value = 1 }
		change_variable = { name = zg361_p3_policy_debt_open_n add = -1 }
		change_variable = { name = zg361_p3_policy_debt_settled_n add = 1 }
	}
	else_if = {
		# Exact settled replay is audit-only and never reaches the KPI sink again.
		limit = {
			has_variable = zg361_p3_m342_debt_owner
			has_variable = zg361_p3_m342_debt_subject
			has_variable = zg361_p3_m342_debt_status
			has_variable = zg361_p3_m342_debt_audit_state

			}

			var:zg361_p3_m342_debt_subject = this
			var:zg361_p3_m342_debt_status = 2
			var:zg361_p3_m342_debt_audit_state = 3
			var:zg361_p3_m342_debt_settled_by = root
			root.var:zg361_review_serial >= var:zg361_p3_m342_debt_settled_cycle
		}
		set_variable = { name = zg361_p3_m342_debt_consumer_status value = 2 }
	}
	else_if = {
		# Complete exact input whose due cycle is later is future, never current work.
		limit = {
			has_variable = zg361_p3_m342_debt_owner
			has_variable = zg361_p3_m342_debt_subject
			has_variable = zg361_p3_m342_debt_cycle
			has_variable = zg361_p3_m342_debt_case
			has_variable = zg361_p3_m342_debt_state
			has_variable = zg361_p3_m342_debt_mechanism
			has_variable = zg361_p3_m342_debt_due_cycle
			has_variable = zg361_p3_m342_debt_status
			has_variable = zg361_p3_m342_debt_audit_state
			has_variable = zg361_p3_m342_debt_business_object_created
			has_variable = zg361_p3_m342_receipt_owner
			has_variable = zg361_p3_m342_receipt_subject

					EXPECTED_CASE = $TICKET_CASE$

					EXPECTED_CHOICE = 3
				}
			}
		}

	}
	else = { set_variable = { name = zg361_p3_runtime_status value = 3 } } # stale no-op

# owner receives the KPI sink; every other pending state blocks new lifecycle work.
zg361_p3_m341_consume_due_debt_effect = {
	remove_variable = zg361_p3_m341_debt_expected_due_cycle

		limit = { has_variable = zg361_p3_m341_debt_cycle }

	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_variable = zg361_p3_m341_debt_owner
			has_variable = zg361_p3_m341_debt_subject

		var:zg361_p3_m341_debt_owner = var:zg361_p3_m341_receipt_owner

		set_variable = { name = zg361_p3_m341_debt_performance_sink value = 1 }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_p3_m341_debt_consumer_status value = 1 }
		change_variable = { name = zg361_p3_policy_debt_open_n add = -1 }
		change_variable = { name = zg361_p3_policy_debt_settled_n add = 1 }
	}
	else_if = {
		# Exact settled replay is audit-only and never reaches the KPI sink again.
		limit = {

			var:zg361_p3_m341_debt_settled_by = root
			root.var:zg361_review_serial >= var:zg361_p3_m341_debt_settled_cycle
		}
		set_variable = { name = zg361_p3_m341_debt_consumer_status value = 2 }
	}
	else_if = {
		# Complete exact input whose due cycle is later is future, never current work.
		limit = {
			has_variable = zg361_p3_m341_debt_owner
			has_variable = zg361_p3_m341_debt_subject
			has_variable = zg361_p3_m341_debt_cycle
			has_variable = zg361_p3_m341_debt_case

			has_variable = zg361_p3_m341_debt_audit_state

			has_variable = zg361_p3_m341_receipt_subject
			has_variable = zg361_p3_m341_receipt_cycle
			has_variable = zg361_p3_m341_receipt_case
			has_variable = zg361_p3_m341_receipt_state
			has_variable = zg361_p3_m341_receipt_choice

				zg361_is_celestial_liege_trigger = yes

			}

			var:zg361_p3_m341_debt_status = 1
			var:zg361_p3_m341_debt_audit_state = 1

			var:zg361_p3_m341_debt_owner = root
			var:zg361_p3_m341_debt_subject = this
		var:zg361_p3_m341_debt_owner = var:zg361_p3_m341_receipt_owner
		var:zg361_p3_m341_debt_subject = var:zg361_p3_m341_receipt_subject
		var:zg361_p3_m341_debt_cycle = var:zg361_p3_m341_receipt_cycle
		var:zg361_p3_m341_debt_case = var:zg361_p3_m341_receipt_case
		var:zg361_p3_m341_debt_state = var:zg361_p3_m341_receipt_state
			var:zg361_p3_m341_receipt_choice = 3
			var:zg361_p3_m341_debt_due_cycle = var:zg361_p3_m341_debt_expected_due_cycle
			root.var:zg361_review_serial < var:zg361_p3_m341_debt_due_cycle
		}
		set_variable = { name = zg361_p3_m341_debt_consumer_status value = 5 }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_p3_policy_debt_consumer_blocked value = 1 }
	}
	else_if = {
		# Pending stale/cross-owner/corrupt identity: fail closed.
		limit = {
			OR = {
				trigger_if = {
					limit = { has_variable = zg361_p3_m341_debt_status }
					var:zg361_p3_m341_debt_status = 1
				}
				trigger_else = { always = no }
				trigger_if = {
					limit = { has_variable = zg361_p3_m341_receipt_choice }
					var:zg361_p3_m341_receipt_choice = 3
				}

		set_variable = { name = zg361_p3_policy_debt_consumer_blocked value = 1 }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_p3_last_red_code value = 60341 }
	}
}
